title: 第8章 名剑太行，突破第四层
slug: 刚成仙神子孙求我出山
content_zh:
“若真能得赏，帮我要一把剑吧，最近对剑法略有领悟，想试试能否创造剑法。”
姜长生笑道，陈礼毕竟是状元郎，其家主更是大景朝户部尚书，在朝堂上确实能说得上话。
陈礼一口答应下来，两人没有聊多久，毕竟杨尚书还在外面。
待房门关上，屋内只剩下姜长生一人，他脸上的笑容消失，他开始担忧敌人会不会派遣更强的高手前来。
希望敌人不要太强，这样还能薅生存奖励。
从陈礼的话来看，绝顶高手虽强，但并非罕见，这就说明绝顶之上有更高的境界，毕竟绝顶高手只是江湖人的称谓，并非境界之名，姜长生需要时间变强。
好在姜长生的担忧是多虑的，接下来数日，每日都有官兵前来，姜长生也被多次谈话，他理直气壮，完全不担心，因为鬼目邪王的奇袭，导致五师兄之死也有了结论。
他是自卫反击！
合情合理，证据充足！
逻辑也通！
只是缺乏动机，官府、刑部、天牢的官员都很困惑，到底是谁在推动这一切，为何要杀姜长生。
姜长生原本期待姜渊亲自来见他，他再顺势引出真相，但姜渊并没有来，皇帝日理万机，没有被这样的案件吸引。
五日后。
四皇子姜誉前来，他兴奋道：“长生哥，你杀鬼目邪王所用的腿法可是你传授我的神影腿？”
姜长生点头，姜誉更加兴奋，开始讲述此事的轰动影响，皇宫内都在议论此事，据说连江湖上都已经传开。
龙起观，长生道士，十四岁击杀鬼目邪王！
这般年纪，这般战绩，确实令人惊奇。
姜长生听后暗爽，但又担心会惹来更多的祸端。
“连我大哥都对你感兴趣，称有机会要来拜访你。”姜誉笑道。
姜长生面不改色，心里则生起杀机。

假太子也想来找他？
不好动。
还是得苟一苟，等足够强，再报仇痛快。
两人又聊了一会儿，姜长生开始指点姜誉在神影腿上的困惑，姜誉认真听，半个时辰下来，收获匪浅，最后感谢一番后离去。
这一次姜誉前来并没有空手而来，送了皇宫里的糕点，姜长生尝后觉得味道不错，比起龙起观的清淡饭菜称得上美味。
不错不错，下次让他多带点。
姜长生美滋滋的想到。
当日，龙起山下被派来一支军队，守护龙起山，让弟子们提心吊胆的日子结束。
一个月后，清虚道长回来，这支军队撤离。
所有弟子聚集在明心殿内，低头面对清虚道长，殿内气氛消沉，姜长生也低着头，孟秋河、孟秋霜跪在清虚道长面前，额头紧贴地面。
清虚道长比起下山前，明显苍老了很多，眉心出现皱纹，估计平时忧虑至极。
“唉。”
一声沉重的叹息打破了明心殿内的沉寂。
清虚道长开口道：“你们起来吧，面对鬼目邪王那等绝顶高手，即便是为师，也没有十足的把握，你们已经做得够好，逝者已逝，从此就不要放在心上。”
孟秋河、孟秋霜起身，依旧不敢抬头，尤其是孟秋河，袖中的双拳颤抖着，这一个月里他性情大变，没有以往那么开朗，整日都阴沉着脸，弟子们都不敢跟他说话。
清虚道长看向姜长生，道：“长生，你表现得不错，你救了龙起观。”
姜长生连忙弯腰行礼，称是应尽之责。
清虚道长没有过多说此事，而是道：“你们的大师兄已经改投魔门，此后，他不再是龙起观的大弟子，秋河为大弟子，秋霜为二弟子，三弟子为长生。”
此言一出，弟子们纷纷抬头，激动的询问。
李长青在龙起观内就是大家长的身份，与弟子们关系亲近，包括姜长生在内，无人讨厌他。

孟秋河脸色极为难看，并没有提升为大弟子的激动。
姜长生被提升为三弟子，倒是不惊讶，战绩摆在那儿，在龙起观弟子的身份是可以调动的，当然，一般是有弟子去世，方才会有其他弟子顶替。
对于李长青的背叛，他能想得通。
情之一字，害人不浅。
只要不影响他的安危就好。
他可是修仙之人，百年之后，如今身边的所有人都将化为黄土，长眠于地底。
清虚道长没有多说，挥动拂尘，示意弟子们退去。
弟子们虽群情激奋，但不得不退下。
姜长生有些迟疑，以为清虚道长会单独跟自己说话，但并没有，他似乎没有将弟子们的死放在心上。
他独自回到自己的房屋内，仍很困惑。
清虚道长对他的态度明显很古怪。
莫非清虚道长知晓他的身份？
特许他不用听道，即便因他出了这么大的事，也没有问责他，实在是不对劲。
姜长生想到许多种可能，甚至想到清虚道长可能也是敌人，当然，这个想法有点阴暗了，奈何他放弃了轮回的机会，这一世无论如何他都要追求长生！
长生不死，成仙封神，是他的目标！
清虚道长回来后，龙起观便彻底镇定下来，弟子们不再担忧，日子恢复如初，弟子们都是孤儿出身，或多或少都经历过生离死别，也没有一直沉浸于悲伤之中，只有一人，深受影响。
孟秋河。
他开始疯狂习武，也获得了与姜长生一样的待遇，不再听道，在山崖边上醉心武学，让青苦都向姜长生感慨这位新大师兄如今练武的劲头跟不要命似的。
姜长生没有多管闲事去安慰孟秋河，他也没有这个能力。
时光继续流逝。

不知不觉。
开元十五年到来，姜长生十五岁。
他的真气一直在增长，但距离道法自然功第四层，始终差了一步。
冬雪还未完全消融，陈礼前来拜访，这一次他带上了一份大礼。
“哈哈哈，长生，你可是捡到宝贝了，我帮你向陛下讨要宝剑，陛下一声令下，花费数月时间，从江湖上讨来一把名剑，此剑名为太行剑，据说在江湖上算得上十大名剑之一。”
陈礼笑道，他将剑放在桌上，碰撞出清脆的声响。
姜长生诧异问道：“陛下这么大动干戈？”
陈礼摇头道：“陛下只是一句话，底下人跑断腿罢了，龙起观位于京城，是陛下亲定的道观，被天牢的死囚屠杀弟子，涉及到的权力部门太多，下面的人为了讨好陛下，自然得尽心尽力，这也是想抹平陛下心中的愤怒，而且当今武林，剑客势弱，十大名剑的威风不如前朝。”
姜长生恍然大悟，他来得桌前，拿起剑鞘，将太行剑拔出，剑光闪耀，晃得他眯眼。
陈礼也被晃了眼睛，感慨道：“太行绝对是神兵利器，我试过，削铁如泥，这剑光还能迷惑敌人。”
姜长生打量太行剑，长达三尺有余，剑刃有三指宽，整体显得纤细，剑刃中间雕刻着奇异的纹路，两侧的剑刃略显青蓝色，剑柄做工同样精细，握着不硌手，反而很舒服。
“不错不错，我喜欢，多谢陈大哥。”
姜长生赞叹道，此剑帅气，配得上他的颜值。
陈礼笑了笑，然后说起此案的结果。
天牢将被重新改造，追求更大的防御能力，已经有超过三十位大小官员被勒职，被砍头的人不下五位，官职最高的涉及到三品大官，这段时间内京城可谓是满城风雨，人人自危，每日都有官府监查城区，皇帝怀疑鬼目邪王背后另有其人，但最终还是没有查到幕后真凶，此案也就这般落幕。
对于龙起观，皇帝赠送了许多钱粮，算是安抚。
姜长生没有意见，他也没有资格发表意见。
陈礼说完后便匆匆离去，最近他升职了，正是忙碌之时。
姜长生没有在屋内待着，而是前往道钟楼上，这附近的弟子很少，因为这里的楼房都是库房，存放着木柴、粮食等货物。
他开始按照御剑诀的心法催动灵气，先要让太行剑腾空，才好御剑，这个过程很难，但他觉得新鲜，斗志满满。

御剑才是修仙啊！
堂堂修仙者，岂能总是用武夫的招式对敌？
龙起观惨案落幕后，那些想杀姜长生的权贵也都安分下来，姜长生十五岁这一年过得很平静，没有再遇到杀祸、劫难。
开元十六年，姜长生十六岁。
在夏日的一个下午，他终于练就道法自然功第四层，体内真气开始转变为更强的能量。
修仙者的能量！
这一刻起，他算是真正超凡，以后可修行法术，还可使用法器。
六岁那年获得的法器麒麟拂尘还在他脑海里，未曾用过，他早就期待使用。
姜长生对比了一下，自身灵力相当于突破前真气的十倍，很庞大，他的感官更是倍涨，听力能覆盖整个龙起观，同时他还诞生了神识，神识乃是灵魂的目力，可穿透物质，窥探外界，窥探事物的本质。
一朝蜕变！
姜长生心情舒畅，觉得再有敌人前来也不用担心。
跟诛杀鬼目邪王时相比，他自身实力已经突飞猛进，甚至可以用脱胎换骨来形容。
用了两日时间，姜长生巩固修为，熟练的掌握灵力，他甚至可以御剑飞行，只是不敢表现得太招摇，稍微试了一下就结束。
他还不确定这天下是否还有其他修仙者，是否有匹敌他的武者，不能肆意妄为。
content_en:
"If you really can get a reward, please help me get a sword. I have recently gained some understanding of swordsmanship and would like to try to create a swordsmanship."
Jiang Changsheng smiled and said, after all, Chen Li is the number one scholar, and the head of his family is the Minister of Household Affairs of the Dajing Dynasty, so he can really speak well in the court.
Chen Li agreed immediately, and the two didn't chat for long. After all, Yang Shangshu was still outside.
After the door closed, Jiang Changsheng was the only one left in the room. The smile on his face disappeared, and he began to worry whether the enemy would send stronger masters.
I hope the enemies are not too strong, so that I can still collect survival rewards.
Judging from Chen Li's words, although top masters are strong, they are not rare. This means that there is a higher realm above the top. After all, top master is just a title for people in the world, not a name for a realm. Jiang Changsheng needs time to become stronger.
Fortunately, Jiang Changsheng's worries were misplaced. In the next few days, officers and soldiers came every day, and Jiang Changsheng was also talked to many times. He was confident and not worried at all, because the surprise attack of the Ghost Eye Evil King had led to the conclusion of the fifth senior brother's death.
He was fighting back in self-defense!
It’s reasonable and the evidence is sufficient!
The logic makes sense too!
There was just a lack of motive, and officials from the government, the Ministry of Punishment, and Tianlao were confused as to who was driving all this and why they wanted to kill Jiang Changsheng.
Jiang Changsheng originally expected Jiang Yuan to come to see him in person and he would take advantage of the situation to elicit the truth, but Jiang Yuan did not come. The emperor had many things to do and was not attracted by such a case.
Five days later.
The Fourth Prince Jiang Yu came and said excitedly: "Brother Changsheng, the kick you used to kill the Ghost Eye Evil King was the Shenying Kick you taught me?"
Jiang Changsheng nodded, and Jiang Yu became even more excited and began to talk about the sensational impact of this matter. Everyone in the palace was talking about this matter, and it was said that it had even spread in the world.
Long Qiguan, the immortal Taoist priest, killed the evil king of ghost eyes at the age of fourteen!
At such an age, such achievements are truly amazing.
Jiang Changsheng was secretly happy after hearing this, but he was worried that it would cause more trouble.
"Even my eldest brother is interested in you and wants to visit you if he has the chance." Jiang Yu said with a smile.
Jiang Changsheng's expression remained unchanged, but murderous intent arose in his heart.
The fake prince also wants to come to him?
Not easy to move.
You still have to be patient and wait until you are strong enough to take revenge.
The two chatted for a while, and Jiang Changsheng began to point out Jiang Yu's confusion on Shenying's lap. Jiang Yu listened carefully. After half an hour, he gained a lot, and finally left after thanking him.
This time Jiang Yu didn't come empty-handed, he brought some pastries from the palace. After Jiang Changsheng tasted them, he thought they tasted good, and they were more delicious than Long Qiguan's light meals.
Not bad, let him bring more next time.
Jiang Changsheng thought happily.
On that day, an army was sent from the foot of Longqi Mountain to guard Longqi Mountain, putting an end to the fearful days of the disciples.
A month later, Taoist Master Qingxu returned and the army withdrew.
All the disciples gathered in the Mingxin Hall and lowered their heads to face Taoist Priest Qingxu. The atmosphere in the hall was gloomy. Jiang Changsheng also lowered his head. Meng Qiuhe and Meng Qiushuang knelt in front of Taoist Priest Qingxu, with their foreheads close to the ground.
Taoist Priest Qingxu is obviously much older than before he came down the mountain. There are wrinkles between his eyebrows. He is probably extremely worried.
"Alas."
A heavy sigh broke the silence in Mingxin Hall.
Taoist Master Qingxu said: "Get up. Even if you are a teacher, you are not completely sure when facing top masters like Ghost Eye Evil King. You have done well enough. The deceased is gone, so don't take it to heart from now on."
Meng Qiuhe and Meng Qiushuang stood up, but still did not dare to raise their heads, especially Meng Qiuhe, whose fists in his sleeves were trembling. His temperament had changed drastically in the past month, and he was not as cheerful as before. He had a gloomy face all day long, and his disciples did not dare to talk to him.
Taoist Priest Qingxu looked at Jiang Changsheng and said, "Changsheng, you performed well. You saved Long Qiguan."
Jiang Changsheng quickly bent down and saluted, saying that he had fulfilled his duty.
Taoist Master Qingxu did not say much about this matter, but said: "Your senior brother has switched to the Demon Sect., after that, he was no longer the first disciple of Longqiguan, Qiuhe was the first disciple, Qiu Shuang was the second disciple, and the third disciple was Changsheng. "
As soon as this was said, the disciples raised their heads and asked excitedly.
Li Changqing is the patriarch in Longqi Temple and is close to the disciples. No one, including Jiang Changsheng, hates him.
Meng Qiuhe's face was extremely ugly, and he was not excited about being promoted to a top disciple.
Jiang Changsheng was not surprised to be promoted to the third disciple. His achievements were there, and his identity as a disciple in Longqi Temple could be transferred. Of course, usually when a disciple dies, another disciple will take his place.
He could understand Li Changqing's betrayal.
The word love can do a lot of harm to people.
As long as it doesn't affect his safety.
He is a cultivator of immortality. A hundred years later, everyone around him will turn into loess and sleep underground forever.
Taoist Master Qingxu didn't say much, and waved his fly whisk to signal the disciples to retreat.
Although the disciples were excited, they had to retreat.
Jiang Changsheng was a little hesitant, thinking that Taoist Master Qingxu would talk to him alone, but he didn't. He didn't seem to care about the deaths of his disciples.
He returned to his house alone, still confused.
Taoist Master Qingxu's attitude towards him was obviously very strange.
Could it be that Taoist Master Qingxu knows his identity?
He was granted permission not to listen to the sermon, but even if such a big thing happened to him, he was not held accountable. It was really wrong.
Jiang Changsheng thought of many possibilities, and even thought that Taoist Master Qingxu might also be an enemy. Of course, this idea was a bit dark, but he gave up the opportunity of reincarnation. He would pursue immortality no matter what in this life!
Immortality, becoming an immortal and becoming a god are his goals!
After Taoist Master Qingxu came back, Long Qiguan completely calmed down. The disciples no longer worried, and life returned to the same state as before. The disciples were all orphans, and they had all experienced life and death more or less, and they were not immersed in sadness all the time. Only one person was deeply affected.
Meng Qiuhe.
He began to practice martial arts crazily, and received the same treatment as Jiang Changsheng. He stopped listening to Taoism and became obsessed with martial arts on the edge of the cliff. Qing Kuqi lamented to Jiang Changsheng that this new senior brother was now practicing martial arts with such vigor that he seemed to risk his life.
Jiang Changsheng didn't mind his own business to comfort Meng Qiuhe, and he didn't have the ability.
Time continues to pass.
Unknowingly.
The fifteenth year of Kaiyuan came and Jiang Changsheng was fifteen years old.
His true energy has been growing, but he is still one step behind the fourth level of Taoist natural skills.
The winter snow has not completely melted yet, Chen Li came to visit, and this time he brought a big gift.
"Hahaha, Changsheng, you have found a treasure. I will ask your Majesty for a sword for you. Your Majesty gave an order and spent several months to get a famous sword from the world. This sword is called Taihang Sword. It is said that it is one of the top ten famous swords in the world. "
Chen Li smiled and put the sword on the table, making a crisp sound when it collided.
Jiang Changsheng asked in surprise: "Your Majesty is so aggressive in going to war? "
Chen Li shook his head and said: "Your Majesty just said a word. The person below broke his leg. Longqi Temple is located in the capital. It is a Taoist temple appointed by His Majesty. His disciples were massacred by the prisoners on death row. There are too many power departments involved. In order to please Your Majesty, the people below naturally have to do their best. This is also to smooth over the anger in His Majesty's heart. Moreover, in today's martial arts world, swordsmen are weak, and the ten famous swords are not as powerful as the previous dynasty. "
Jiang Changsheng suddenly understood. He came to the table, picked up the scabbard, and pulled out the Taihang Sword. The sword's light shone brightly, making him squint his eyes.
Chen Li was also stunned and said with emotion: "Taihang is definitely a magic weapon. I have tried it. It can cut iron like mud, and the light of this sword can also confuse the enemy. "
Jiang Changsheng looked at the Taihang Sword. It was more than three feet long. The blade was three fingers wide, and the whole sword looked slender. There were strange lines carved in the middle of the blade. The blades on both sides were slightly greenish blue. The hilt was also made of fine workmanship. It did not irritate the hand, but was very comfortable to hold.
"Not bad, I like it, thank you ChenBig brother. "
Jiang Changsheng praised, this sword is handsome and worthy of his appearance.
Chen Li smiled and then talked about the outcome of the case.
The Tianlao will be remodeled to pursue greater defense capabilities. More than 30 officials, big and small, have been strangled, and no less than five people have been beheaded. The highest official position involves a third-grade official. During this period of time, the capital was full of storms, and everyone was in danger. The city was monitored by officials every day. The emperor suspected that there was someone else behind the evil king, but in the end the real culprit was not found, and the case ended like this.
To Long Qiguan, the emperor gave him a lot of money and food as a token of appeasement.
Jiang Changsheng had no opinion, and he was not qualified to express it.
After Chen Li finished speaking, he left in a hurry. He was recently promoted and was busy.
Jiang Changsheng did not stay in the house, but went to the Dao Bell Tower. There were very few disciples nearby because the buildings here were all warehouses where firewood, grain and other goods were stored.
He began to activate the spiritual energy according to the mental method of sword control. He first made the Taihang Sword fly into the air before he could control the sword. This process was difficult, but he felt fresh and full of fighting spirit.
Controlling a sword is the way to cultivate immortality!
How can a dignified immortal cultivator always use martial arts moves to fight against the enemy?
After the Long Qiguan tragedy came to an end, the powerful people who wanted to kill Jiang Changsheng also settled down. Jiang Changsheng lived a peaceful life in his fifteenth year, and did not encounter any more murders or disasters.
In the sixteenth year of Kaiyuan, Jiang Changsheng was sixteen years old.
One summer afternoon, he finally mastered the fourth level of Taoist natural skills, and the true energy in his body began to transform into stronger energy.
The energy of a cultivator!
From this moment on, he is truly extraordinary and can practice magic and use magic weapons in the future.
The magical weapon Qilin Whisk he obtained when he was six years old is still in his mind. It has never been used, and he has long been looking forward to using it.
Jiang Changsheng made a comparison and found that his spiritual power was ten times the amount of Qi before the breakthrough, which was very huge. His senses were doubled, and his hearing could cover the entire Longqi Temple. At the same time, he also gave birth to spiritual consciousness. Divine consciousness is the vision of the soul, which can penetrate matter, peer into the outside world, and peer into the essence of things.
Transformed once!
Jiang Changsheng was in a good mood and felt that there was no need to worry if enemies came again.
Compared with when he killed the Ghost Eye Evil King, his own strength has improved by leaps and bounds, and can even be described as reborn.
It took two days for Jiang Changsheng to consolidate his cultivation and master spiritual power proficiently. He could even fly with a sword, but he didn't dare to show off too ostentatiously, so he tried it for a while and it was over.
He is still not sure whether there are other immortal cultivators in the world, whether there are warriors who can match him, so he cannot act recklessly.
